Messages.Author: Orpheus
Messages.Body:
Spirit Marionette
[BL]
Cardtype: Action
Discipline: Obeah/Dominate
[dom] (D) Bleed at +1 bleed.
[obe] (D) Bleed at +1 bleed, and tap a ready minion controlled by your prey
(even if the target of the bleed is changed).
[OBE] +1 stealth action. (D) Take control of any ready untapped minion until
the end of the next action. That minion must bleed your prey unless he or
she must hunt.

If you tap that minion, say, with Jar the Soul, do you keep control of him
until he can untap / bleed ?

If you tap him and then use Force of Will, you then lose control of him,
right ?

--

> action. (D) Take control of any ready untapped minion until the end of

> hunt.
>
> If you tap that minion, say, with Jar the Soul, do you keep control of
> him until he can untap / bleed ?

You can't, because bleeding is a mandatory action so it *must* take place
before Jaring any Soul.

> If you tap him and then use Force of Will, you then lose control of him,
> right ?

Provided you find a way to tap him without taking any action, yes.

Francois

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Orpheus wrote:
>
> Spirit Marionette
> [BL]
> Cardtype: Action
> Discipline: Obeah/Dominate
> [dom] (D) Bleed at +1 bleed.
> [obe] (D) Bleed at +1 bleed, and tap a ready minion controlled by your prey
> (even if the target of the bleed is changed).
> [OBE] +1 stealth action. (D) Take control of any ready untapped minion until
> the end of the next action. That minion must bleed your prey unless he or
> she must hunt.
>
> If you tap that minion, say, with Jar the Soul, do you keep control of him
> until he can untap / bleed ?

The target must be untapped (card text).
Mandatory actions (like the bleed the target must then perform) must be
taken before any non-mandatory ones (like Jar the Soul) can be attempted.

> If you tap him and then use Force of Will, you then lose control of him,
> right ?

Again, very difficult to tap him, but you lose control of the target at the
end of the next action (card text).

You know, in case anyone hadn't noticed already, you *can*
get Khobar Towers usage with Spirit Marionette, if you
use Madness Network.

Your Malkavian (with Obeah) uses Spirit Marionette after
your predator finishes with minion actions; as long as
you're grabbing a non-Malkavian you'll keep it until your
own minion phase. (If it were a Malk I think it'd have
to bleed immediately, since it'd be allowed to act via
Madness Network - LSJ?)

During your untap, Khobar away! Yow. And you don't
even need the Misdirection. Just a Clan Impersonated
Salubri and the Madness Network. And a Follower of Set
so you can get Khobar Towers. You know, this plan may
be good enough to try for myself. (OK, funny enough to
try for myself.)

Josh

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Joshua Duffin wrote:
> Your Malkavian (with Obeah) uses Spirit Marionette after
> your predator finishes with minion actions; as long as
> you're grabbing a non-Malkavian you'll keep it until your
> own minion phase. (If it were a Malk I think it'd have
> to bleed immediately, since it'd be allowed to act via
> Madness Network - LSJ?)

No. Malks are not obligated to act via the Net, even
if they have mandatory actions. A Malk with a mandatory
action cannot perform any other action via the Net,
however. [RTR 28-NOV-1994], [LSJ 18-JAN-2002]

Well, you keep control of the vamp until the end of the next action, so you could do
a few things. You could use that vampire for blocking, you could Rave with one of
your other Malkavians. The next player might not take any actions for a number of
reasons: you just stole his last minion, he wants the minion you stole to get wasted,
you made some sort of deal with him, etc...

On the other hand, you're right that the SM kind of ruins the nifty combo of hunt
every turn for lots of blood, or hunting, acting and freak driving every turn for
lots of nifty actions. If I could make such a deck, I would probably put in the
possibility for both combos to work.

You could probably make a very nifty Salubri/Malkav pool machine/interceptor deck,
and could even use all of the Salubri, since you need CI in order to make it work
anyway. Spirit Marionette would just become kind of a side-bar in that sort of
deck... to the point where you might even skip the Settites and not use Khobar
Towers. If you can empty the vamp with Heidelberg, that should probably be enough.
